content.mainEmotionalMessage: Loraine, Baby, I am so grateful that life gave me the chance to know you, love you, and share this part of my life with you. This website is a little piece of my heart, made especially for you.

chapterOne.heading: Before We Knew What Our Story Would Become
chapterOne.quote: Some beginnings don’t announce how important they will become. Sometimes, life simply lets two people meet, and only time reveals how much that moment will mean.
paragraphs: Around June 15–20, 2016, our paths crossed for the very first time. Back then, it was simply a quiet moment in time—two lives intersecting without knowing what the future held.

We did not know then what our story would eventually become, and there was no grand script telling us where the years would lead. Yet looking back today, I feel a quiet gratitude that life allowed us to meet when we did, planting the earliest seed of a connection that time would later turn into something deeply meaningful.

chapterTwo.heading: The Day You Became My Baby
paragraphs: Years after we first met, October 26, 2022 became the day our relationship officially began—the day "you and I" truly became "us," and the day you became my Baby.

Having someone to share life with—someone whose presence brings warmth, honesty, and comfort to ordinary days—is one of life’s greatest gifts. Starting this official chapter with you gave new meaning to every season that followed.
chapterTwo.imageCaption: The beginning of a chapter I will always be grateful for.

chapterThree.heading: Every Little Moment Matters
chapterThree.subtitle: A love story is not only built on milestone dates; it lives inside the quiet conversations, shared laughter, and everyday moments we choose to treasure.

chapterFour.heading: Four Years of Loving You, Baby
paragraphs: Today, on October 26, 2026, we celebrate four official years of being together—and more than a decade since life first let our paths cross in June 2016.

Real love is not meaningful because everything is effortless or perfect. It is meaningful because two people choose to keep learning, communicating, growing, and appreciating one another through every season. Thank you for every conversation, every bit of patience, every shared smile, and every day we have chosen to care for each other.
chapterFour.imageCaption: Four years of choosing, appreciating, and loving you, Baby.

chapterFive.heading: My Favorite Chapters Are Still Ahead
paragraphs: As grateful as I am for the memories behind us, my heart feels even warmer when I think about the days still ahead—the quiet mornings, the shared laughter, the new places we will see, and the gentle comfort of continuing to grow side by side.
chapterFive.personalWishPlaceholder: My wish for our future, Baby, is that we keep choosing each other with patience, kindness, and gratitude—building a life full of peaceful days, honest conversations, warm laughter, and memories we will still be smiling about years from now.
chapterFive.closingLine: Baby, thank you for being part of my story. I look forward to discovering the next chapters with you.

thingsIMayNotSayEnoughLetter.heading: To My Baby, Loraine
thingsIMayNotSayEnoughLetter.requiredPassage: Baby, sometimes I wonder if I tell you enough how grateful I am for you. Maybe I don't always find the perfect words, and maybe there are moments when I could express it better. But I hope you never forget that your presence in my life means so much to me. I appreciate the person you are, the moments we share, and the chance to keep building this story together.
paragraphs: When life gets busy and days move quickly, it is easy to assume that the person beside us already knows what is in our heart. Today, I wanted to slow down and put these feelings into words so you never have to guess how deeply I value you.

I am so thankful that our paths first crossed back in June 2016, and even more thankful that on October 26, 2022, we began our official journey as a couple. Over these four years together, the little things—our conversations, your kindness, your effort, and the comfort of simply being near you—have meant more to me than I often say out loud.

I know that no relationship is perfect, and neither of us has to be flawless for our love to be deeply real. What matters to me is the care we bring to one another, the patience we practice, and the way we keep choosing to listen, understand, and grow together.

More than anything, I always want you to feel appreciated, respected, safe, and cherished with me. I never want you to feel that your love, your time, or your presence in my life is something I take for granted.
thingsIMayNotSayEnoughLetter.customDetailPlaceholder: I WILL ALWAYS LOVE YOU BABY
closingLines: Thank you for being you, Baby. Thank you for being part of my life, and thank you for giving me so many reasons to be grateful for our story.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: One Thing I Will Always Appreciate About You
twelveLoveNotes.message: Baby, I will always appreciate the sincerity, warmth, and genuine heart you bring into my life. You make my world softer and brighter just by being in it.
Whenever you smile, Baby, it has a way of softening even the heaviest day. Your smile is still one of my favorite sights in the whole world.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: A Little Thing That Makes Me Happy
twelveLoveNotes.message: It doesn’t take a grand occasion for me to feel happy with you. Simply sharing quiet time together, talking with you, and knowing you are by my side brings so much peace to my heart.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: A Memory That Makes Me Smile
twelveLoveNotes.message: Whenever my mind wanders back to the moments we have laughed and talked together without a care in the world, I find myself smiling all over again. Thank you for giving me memories that feel like home.
I deeply admire the person you are, Loraine—your strength, your kindness, and the care you show to the people who matter to you. Walking beside you makes me so grateful.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: For the Days You Feel Tired
twelveLoveNotes.message: On the days when you feel exhausted or overwhelmed, Baby, please remember you don’t have to carry everything alone. I am always here to listen, to hold space for you, and to remind you how much you are loved.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: Why I Am Proud of You
twelveLoveNotes.message: I am so proud of the effort you put into your life and the grace you show through every season. Seeing you keep moving forward inspires me more than you know.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: Something I Want to Thank You For
twelveLoveNotes.message: Thank you for your patience, your care, and the effort you give to us. Most of all, thank you for choosing to share your heart and your time with me. I never take it for granted.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: Something I Hope You Never Doubt
twelveLoveNotes.message: Even on quiet days or imperfect moments, I hope you never doubt that you matter deeply to me, that I respect and cherish you, and that I am genuinely grateful you are my Baby.
My wish for us is that we continue to protect our peace, laugh often, communicate openly, and keep making time for the moments that bring us closer.

twelveLoveNotes.theme: Something I Want Us to Keep Doing
twelveLoveNotes.message: No matter how many years pass, I want us to keep appreciating the small moments, checking in on each other’s hearts, and never losing the warmth that makes us who we are.
Here is one last truth from my heart, Baby: creating this little world for our fourth anniversary made me fall in love with our story all over again. I love you so much, Loraine.

sealedSurpriseLetter.preRevealIntro: Baby, before you leave this little world I made for you, there is one more thing I want you to read.
sealedSurpriseLetter.preRevealSubtext: I saved these words for you, because some feelings deserve a special place.
paragraphs: If you are reading this, you have walked through the little world I built for you. I wanted to create a quiet space away from everything else—not to show off or make something flashy, but simply because you are worth the time, the thought, and the care it took to put my heart into something you can hold onto.

When I look back at our timeline, it still amazes me how life works. We first crossed paths around June 15–20, 2016, long before either of us knew what we would eventually mean to each other. Then came October 26, 2022—the day our relationship officially began—and now here we are on October 26, 2026, celebrating four years of being us.
If I could return to the beginning of our story, knowing what I know today, I would still be grateful for the chance to meet you, to know you, and to discover the love we would share.

Through these four years, I have learned that the most treasured parts of love are rarely the loudest ones. They live in the quiet comfort of knowing someone cares about your day, the warmth of a familiar smile, and the gratitude that deepens with time when we choose not to take each other for granted.

Baby, I don't want this anniversary to be only about counting the years. I want it to remind you that there is someone who is thankful for you, who values the moments you share, and who wants to keep making space for more beautiful memories with you.

Thank you for being gentle with my heart, for sharing your life with me, and for every honest effort that has brought us to our fourth anniversary. You are deeply loved, Loraine—today and in all the chapters we have yet to write.
sealedSurpriseLetter.closingSubheadline: Four years of being us. A lifetime of memories still waiting to be made.
closingGratitudeLines: Loraine, thank you for being part of my life.
Thank you for the memories we have made.
Thank you for the chance to keep writing our story together.
I am so grateful for you, Baby.
sealedSurpriseLetter.closingSignOff: Forever grateful for this chapter of us,
sealedSurpriseLetter.personalMessagePlaceholder: Baby, thank you for four wonderful years of being my love, my comfort, and my favorite person. Every day since October 26, 2022 has been a gift because I get to share it with you. I love you always, Loraine.

My sincere promise to you is to keep listening with an open heart, communicating honestly even when life is busy, appreciating the little things you do, and always making real time for us.
